book.title: Yohaneŋo Don San Papaine Ea Ra Qelaŋange

content: Aŋelo Naba 5 Eŋe Romon Paungi Sila Loutne Wakongoi
Pakiso aŋelo naba 5, eŋe romonine puangi, na kawe serekin mane qeliwo ŋine qoe kepo ket kitoke, eŋe giwe mane kaine mi kakaine ea wane ki mange.
Serekinŋo giwe yewa lalaŋgiso, kopu ea ŋine qake saketke, gerep suaine mane ze more, kopune samaike, yale sake. Kopu giweo ŋine sake, eaŋo kepe deinane qelaŋane so qeli qekatkeki, kepe panamange.
Paki kopu koto ŋine sila wakone ket more, kepeo kitou, so eŋe wame golaŋ wane zonom yale, yewa ebongoi.
Pakiso eŋe touk, me eki, me waet kine kine natne mi ŋaba onikei wane edangoi. Eŋe weku ŋei, Anutu wane kibiŋo meeno mi okoramaike, eŋeka maine ŋaba onikei wane edange.
Sila eŋe ŋei yewa edotpi seukkei wane mida, yaup wikile ebone geu, meso 5 okaniakane. Edotpi, wikile desikei, eamo ŋei mane wame golaŋŋo kiki, naso yewao wikile detmaike, ea wane kop wikile desikei.
Meso 5 naso yewao, ŋei yewa eŋe baŋ seu seu zuaŋkaikei, ŋo siluŋ eŋe baŋ mi maratkaikei, eŋe baŋ seukkei wane oniake, ŋo siluŋ seu seu eŋe baŋ eŋano ŋine kakakone ariake.

Sila eŋe horsi yale ongole, kawali ŋei edo horsi kawaliwo arikei wane rau paki, kine kine mauluke ebonbi ma arimami yale, eŋane leweteno yemo gol marok yale metwareke, eso kaiteneŋo yemo ŋei eŋane kait yale.
Eŋane lewetene zoune, yemo ŋerep eŋane lewet zoune yale, eŋane ŋetene yemo laion wane ŋetne yale.
Eŋane moiyakeno, yemo aen sukuku yalineŋo kawetkake, eso qingimene ukatne, yemo horsi loutneŋo horsi kare warage kawali ŋetno arimami, eŋane ukat yale.
Eŋe daeeneŋo wikile ebo ebon marasenene ea yemo wame golaŋ wane yale daeeno metmaike. Eso eŋe zonomene daeeno metmaikane, eŋe ŋei meso 5 wikile ebone gekei.
Eŋe ŋei waomene mane wareone gemaike, eŋe yemo aŋelo, oŋo giwe ea wareka gemaike. Eŋane eŋetine Hebru dongo, Abadon, ŋo Grik dongo yemo Apolion, kine “Matali matali”.
Kakarauk alakan wane ea mo midamaike. Yai! Kakarauk etke ea pamaike, iwa wane ŋado baŋ sariake.
Aŋelo Naba 6 Romon Puangi Kawali Ŋei Magu Suaine Wakongoi
Pakiso aŋelo naba 6, eŋe romonine puange. Puangi Na detpe, don mane gol arata ugurukine 4, Anutu wane kaitko okorake ea ŋine sarike.
Don eaŋo aŋelo naba 6, romon ma okorake, eŋe olale rake, “Aŋelo 4 Yupretis Doku suaino lukongoi, eŋe siwotonnom!”
Rakiso, eŋe aŋelo naba 4 yewa, eŋe mo koma yewao meso, kaiwe, aua, bomileki kepe baŋem ŋei magu natne engu warekei wane toma gekoi, eŋe siwotonge.
Kawali ŋei horsi kutno met metne eŋane zaleene 200 milion, yale rau detkole.

Horsi so ŋei kutno metkoi, eŋane kait toqaene dene zingeki, iwa yale kakole, eŋe malokuene ebekkoi, ea wane kibine yemo weŋe weŋem gerep yale, buyeka aso aso yale, so takuka solpa wesi yale. Horsi eŋane lewetene laion eŋane lewet yale. Aŋaeno ŋine gerep, kopu so wesi gereune saketke.
Kine kine gereune karewe yewaŋo ŋei magu karewe enguke. Gerep, kopu so wesi solpa horsi aŋaeno ŋine saketke yewaŋo.
Horsi eŋane zonomene, yemo aŋaeno so daeno metmaike. Eŋane daeene yemo koma yale, lewetene weneŋ eŋe yewaŋo ŋei engu okanmami.

Ŋei natne korop masi qotkoine karewe iwaŋo mi enguke, eŋe gege mageene okane ma gekoi, ea mi ŋadek kau paki, wetene maingekoi. Eŋe osoŋa isisi, so alaŋ lopio gol, silwa, bras wesi so ekiŋo mamaine, deŋo mi kayake, mi desiake, mi ariake, eŋe meŋen one gekoi, ea mi qeliŋgoi, eŋe magekoi.
Me eŋe tebe kawaliene suŋa qareene, terewenipene, me kobu mamaene, ea mi qeliŋ warekoi.
